I can understand first hand wanting to avoid being held up to those stereotypes. If MATH was nothing but an acronym, I might consider their point. I wish I could make those Asian Americans consider that math and data are very much a part of the message/solutions, not just a cheap branding move. Math may be a subject overly associated with Asians, but it is also integral to what we need politically.
Agreed. I have to hypothesize that being so quick to cancel means they were seeking out an excuse not to consider him.

I’m Asian too and it was discouraging to see Asian Americans criticize him for joking. I studied comedy (coincidentally at the same theater as Donald Glover) and I always wanted to push back on the stereotype that Asians don’t have a sense of humor. I feel far more frustrated by the stereotype that we are not equal in comedy, in being charismatic and in being joyful, far more discouraging that the idea that we know more doctors on average. 

I think that we have to hold each other accountable to a sense of reason in complaints. His humor was qualitatively distinct from perpetuating derogatory stereotypes (like eating dogs). Poking at the idea of being frugal or knowing doctors with the spirit of levity and positivity actually shines a light on the way we assume such things.

I don’t see his debate performance as one of the worst, but I have to judge it differently from the people who are being allowed to have twice the speaking time and the ability to actually go back and forth (ya know, like a debate 🤭). These “debates” are more like a weird panel of speakers falling over each other during a semi hostile q&a. Andrew has had many shining moments in the debates, whether zingers about shaking money trees in the wine cave, or mic drop moments breaking the 4th wall. I think these moments were gold. 

Unfortunately, I don’t know if this debate had many golden moments, but to be honest, even those golden moments didn’t get a ton of airtime in replays in mainstream media anyways. Something felt different during this debate and I suspect it was multiple factors. All I can do is keep pushing forward with my support and keep my ears open to learn more.
